# Mid <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Strings](Language-Features-Strings)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Mid:String string:String, start:Int32, count:Int32=-1
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | In | String | required | The text. |
| `start` | In | Int32 | required | Position of the first character to take. |
| `count` | In | Int32 | `-1` | How many characters to take. Defaults to all that are left. |

**Returns:** The piece of the string.

## Description

Returns a piece from the middle of a string. The first character is number 1. Without a count it takes everything to the end, and a count that is too long is cut off at the end.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Mid$("hello", 2, 3)
Print Mid$("hello", 3)
```

```text
ell
llo
```
